title: Internal Storybook
intro: Who can open the internal Storybook at {url}. People on this list sign in with Google — a Noalhub account is not required.
adminsNote: Every account with the admin role gets in without being listed here, so an empty table does not mean nobody has access.
emailWarning: The email must be the exact Google address they sign in with. Their Noalhub account address is irrelevant — a mismatch means they get a 403.
caption: People granted access to the internal Storybook
addTitle: Grant access to the internal Storybook
noteHint: So a later reviewer knows why this email is here. For example: contract designer, reviewing through Q4.
revokeBody: Effective immediately: their open session is refused on the next page load, not at sign-in expiry.
